review_description: The team at Solar Tactics have consistently been a pleasure to work with. They made it easy to get started with solar a few years ago with panels and an inverter, and I've recently had a battery installed by them too.Communication, professionalism and efficiency are all outstanding and I have no concerns about recommending them to anyone in the future.

For expansion of existing system, we wanted to use the same company as previous owners, to minimise chance of warranty troubles if something went wrong and for knowledge of existing system. Sales process was responsive and patient.  Installation was on time.  Installers were polite and helpful. There were a few issues (at Enphase) with transferring Enphase enlighten monitoring into my name, which Solar Tactics assisted with. The price quoted wasn't super cheap, but we had limited roof space and expected and got a microinverter and panel installation that has worked well.

Have my solar system install by Solar Tactics on the 14/11/2023. They where very professional in term of approach and work been carried out.Sales/quoting process was precise and clear in outline all the necessary rebate and warranty.Installation was very professional done and keep the area tidy afterward.Customer service was great and when out of there way to get everything is up and running.Highly recommend them for anything relate to Solar and Electrical work.I even have a Zappi V2.1 EV charger install by them.

Sale was a breeze with no issues ,all question answered and they did not try to sell me something I didn't need in fact the opposite I thought I had done my research and  knew what i needed but I was only going to waste money on panels I didn't need. Install was done on the date set and the boys couldn't be more professional . The whole install went smoothly and connection to the grid , inspections and explanations on setting up the inverter (we bought Fronius ) was done without any problems . These guys know their stuff and I highly recommend them.
Solar Tactics gets great reviews because they're friendly, helpful, and their prices seemed competitive too. I can definitely recommend.

Was referred to Solar Tactics from my sister who got a 11kw system installed through them in 2022. The whole quoting process was simple and streamlined. We had good communication with the company throughout. We went for an 6.64kw system. Even the installation was simple, just had to wait a few weeks for the rain to subside after my rebate was approved. On installation day, everything went smoothly and the guys made the inverter look so slick with how they did all the cables, the panels look so good too especially now those unsightly individual DC isolators aren’t mandatory anymore. System is up and running and working well. Luckily for us we only had to wait a few days before the electrical inspector came around and signed everything off and we could fire it up.

Quoting was quick & competitive - great value, Install on Tim and very neat with an excellent team doing the install, and a positive outcome - a big reduction in our electricity bills. They did all the paperwork and grid connection was quick. Very happy with Solar Tactics
Quoting process was easyCustomer service A+They helped to organise all aspects and made the transaction smooth

The team was informative and responsive both during the quoting process and installation. The installation went very smoothly with no issues at all so far. The installation team was very polite and left the place very clean and tidy. Overall it was an excellent customer experience. The price wasn’t the cheapest however the experience I had with the team was the best.

Jason and the team from Solar Tactics provided a high quality solar system, great communication during the install and after-sales support and were very cost competitive.I'd highly rate them for a solar install, and I found them to be great at listening for the specific kind of system i was after and then working within that budget/needs (Future rental home - medium level investment etc.)The installers were also great about dealing with a roof that was a little worse for wear including shuffling tiles around and sealing a couple up that was not expected, but very appreciated.Finally, I really valued that Solar Tactics were happy to overprovision panels and they were concious of placing my inverter in a sensible location out of the sun, despite it being a more complex cable run.(Only received STC 'rebates' wasn't eligible for others)
The Solar Tactics team went above and beyond in my opinion.  I would highly recommend Solar Tactics for any solar installation. Professional but personable is how I would describe the team.

The end-to-end experience with Solar Tactics was nothing short of great. I was never pressured into buying anything, they were very informative answering many questions I had and very prompt in their replies to the questions.During the install process, the team was very friendly, respectful and worked very hard to deliver a great outcome.  They are trustworthy and left the working area very tidy.The whole process was managed by their team end-to-end and it was as seamless as you can reasonably expect.Highly recommended!

The quoting process was efficient and simple - they revised the system quickly upon my request. The installation team were friendly, flexible and knowledgeable. They left the site tidy and did a fantastic job. The panels look amazing and it all works very well.

From the outset, Jason was prompt with quotes and always helpful. I wanted a local company with good reviews and certainly found them. Dennison was friendly, hard- working, tidy and led the installation. Peregrina communicated superbly at all stages and the grid connection was seamless. The app is amazing. Solar Tactics excel in all ways. I would recommend them fully.

Wonderful from start to finish. From my first call right through to the installation and after service, I have been so impressed.I was kept informed along the way and everything I was told would happen, did happen.Punctual, tidy, polite, friendly and a team of people who have customer service and workmanship at the forefront.I am so pleased I chose Solar Tactics and would have no hesitation using them again and recommending them to others.Absolutely a 10/10 experience.Thank you for making this such a pleasant experience.
Thanks again for a hassle free installation. Customer service was second to none. I will definitely recommend Solar Tactics. Very happy customer

Very happy with the whole process. Jason was very quick and knowledgeable with all my solar newbie questions after receiving the quote! Then when we decided to go ahead the installation process was very quick and Denison the installer was great! I had questions about the app a few weeks later and Denison called back straight away and took the time to walk me thru everything again! Our bill has significantly dropped the past month after having these installed, and I highly recommend the guys at Solar Tactics!

Very pleasant experience from beginning to the end. The price quote is very competitive. The installation was arranged very quickly after the rebate approval was granted. The whole team is great to deal with. They helped organize the grid connection after the install. Highly recommended!

We were very happy with the entire process. The team were friendly, punctual, and they were good in explaining the system to us.The installation went very smoothly and hassle free. It’s now 3 months since installation and we have had no problems. We will happily recommend them to others. Thanks so much for great service.

Wish I had this done sooner than later but I sat on the quote for over 12 months. Then I took the plunge and went ahead with a revised quote of course.From the beginning to end everything went perfectly could not be faulted in any aspect of the job. Everyone I had dealings with were always very prompt, polite, tidy (wow they cleaned up so well) and on schedule.A very professional company which I have recommended to a friend and they also couldn’t talk more highly of the company.

SolarTactics made the entire process easy. The team provided very valuable knowledge and insight which helped land on my decision.The installation team was very professional and delivered first class tidy and well designed system functioning system in the promised timeframe. They were happy to run me through everything in a way I could understand!I would 100% recommend SolarTactics for family and friends, if not for their friendly experience then their quality product!

Jason in sales was great to chat with. I asked for numerous changes to my quote as I learned my way through products. He was very accommodating and quick. In the end we choose a Sungrow inverter (Sungrow Hybrid SH6.0RS) and battery (Sungrow SBR096) with Q-Cell panels (Q-Cells Q.MAXX BLK-G4+ 390).The installation team was by far the best part. Dennison is awesome to work with. He and his team were very respectful and caring with our property, keeping it clean and undamaged. They were very detailed in their work and cared about what I thought regarding some decisions that had to be made. He is easy to get in contact with in the days/weeks following the installation for any questions or problems too.Solar Tactics organised the certifier, grid connection and all paperwork needed with my energy retailer. I will recommend them to anyone who asks me about Solar, in fact I already have!! Service and installation is everything.

Solar Tactics are simply amazing. We had our Solar roof top system installed 3 years ago, with which we are delighted, and have reaped the $ benefits. We have now recently added a Solar battery to the system.From the Solar System quote with Alan in 2019, and his continuing advice regarding a battery, then the recent Battery Quote and unlimited explanations with Jason, to the installation from Dennison and Callum, the whole process was easy to understand, professionally conducted, and Peregrina in the office maintained the information flow superbly.We cannot recommend Solar tactics highly enough, and when our plug in Hybrid car comes into being they shall be there to assist with the installation of that system as well.Well done to all at Solar Tactics: they are THE BEST.

All three solar installer quotes were received within several days of requesting. One price was notably higher than the other two and this company came from the other side of Melbourne, rather than local to my location, so they were eliminated on that basis. The other two quotes were similar in price and both companies were located not too far away. Both offers were based on what appeared to be excellent quality components so it could have gone either way.Solar Tactics offered an alternative price which was inclusive of a QCell battery and further discussion then took place regarding this component. The final decision went to them mainly because the inverter and battery are integrated, which seemed to me to be a good idea. The follow-up from the remaining company was also excellent and they were perhaps unlucky to miss out as it could easily have gone either way, and I would have no hesitation in using them.The Solar Tactics representative was helpful in working through the various paperwork, applications, etc and there were no problems. The Solar Tactics crew came to install the solar system approximately two weeks after I paid the deposit and took two days to do the job, They were quiet, careful and efficient and there were no hassles other than a minor problem setting up the monitoring system due to a faulty dongle, which was sorted out a couple of days later.

Solar tactics came out twice before installing as our install was not straight forward.They reworked the design a number of times to ensure I was satisfied.The installers were very professional and a delight to deal with.Independent inspection happened within a couple of days and system was switched on.Assisted with set up of the app for the inverter.

We had an exceptional experience with Solar Tactics. All the way from the first call to help with a quote to after install checkin call. Jason was extremely helpful and very accommodating, at no point was pushy to sell. After finding solar tactics through a search on www.solarquotes.com.au, I sent through a huge list of questions to Jason, who replied to each one and explained the responses very clearly and was very helpful to answer my follow-up questions. The panel design and layout was well thought out to maximise catching as much solar as possible during sunrise and sunset as our house is NE facing. And the system we decided to go with was a 6Kw Fronius system with 21 Q-Cells (7.35Kw).I asked for multiple revisions of the quote and options and Jason was more than happy to help.The install from Formosa Electrics was very smooth and not disruptive. We were a bit unlucky having to delay the install a few times with two lock downs. But when it got done the installers were very professional and explained how to operate the system. They left the property nice and tidy and also wore masks when on site as per my instructions.After the install we noticed one of the panels visible from the yard was a little lower than the others. I called Jason and within hours the installers came over to check the panel and found one of the holding screws needed adjusting. 5 mins and nice and straight panels.We've now had solar for about 8 months, and compared to the last two years we've reduced our bills in summer by 70-80% and winter by 40-50%, which is on par with what was quoted in the payback period of 5 years (see charts attached).Thanks SolarTactics, I highly recommend.

Jason and his team at Solar Tactics where excellent from the very start, happy to help with any questions I had about the technology, ROI, quote, solar approval process and the installation.  Their communication during the application process, the lead up to installation day and then afterwards was spot on and they have continued to provide support when I had questions.  The installation went without a hitch and the installation team were efficient, considerate and cleaned up after themselves.  They didn't leave until they had setup the monitoring and explained how everything worked.  I had them upgrade the meter box at the same time.  Jason called me the next day to check how everything went.  Can't fault anything they did.

No pressure sales process over a two month period after initial quote and negotiated a different inverter along with a monitoring plan.After accepting and providing a deposit, system was installed after another month. The installers were prompt, professional and even worked in the pouring rain. Would have understood if they had to rescheduled due to the weather but they got it done before the end of the day.inspection occurred about two weeks later with no issues mentioned by the inspector. The sparky paid another visit the same day to make sure the inverter was working properly and I had access to the monitor.Customer service organised the grid connection and signed off with the energy retailer for the FIT after another week. Looking forward to the first energy bill and then negotiating for a better plan in the near future.

Highly recommend the team at Solar Tactics. I have had my solar for over 12 months and had no issues at all. Price was competitive and the guys that installed did an extremely neat and tidy job. Their after sales services has been amazing and a special shout out to Dennison who went above and beyond to give great customer service. I was connected to the grid within a week and I received all the paperwork in a timely manner. Would be my first choice if I ever move to another property without solar and will use them for any upgrades in the future.
Did a great job, arrived on time, very professional. Organised the grid connection, set up the WiFi app to check real time solar generation very happy with the service.

The installer contacted me within days of asking for a quote, and were happy to answer any questions I had, even as I was new to the whole process. Quote was very informative and installation and post-setup was incredibly easy and stress-free, and I barely had to do anything myself to get my solar system up and running.

I spent months learning what hardware to buy and what makes for a good installation. I am part of various Solar groups on Facebook; I learned about clamp zones, exclusions zones, what is up to code, what is not and saw tons of horror stories there.As someone who has a decent idea of what I am looking at now, I am super happy with the tidy work that SolarTactics have done. It was quality hardware, installed very cleanly and up to code.There were also other little niceties, like running a network cable from my Inverter to my network rack's patch panel and even giving thought to which port to hook it up to, to keep my wiring neat.My original install date was delayed because of the Victorian Covid lockdowns. Solar Tactics was highly communicative, letting me know what they could and couldn't do as the rules changed. They never left me wondering what the next step was.As soon as they could get back to work, they had me booked in within two weeks and had a large team install it all in about 5 hours. Left the area clean and tidy, friendly and professional the whole time.They made sure I understood how to use everything before leaving and got the process started on their end with my energy retailer, whose inspector came about five days later (who also said they did a really good job).About one or two weeks after it was running, Solar Tactics gave me a follow-up call to ask how it was all going, if I had any questions etc..Overall, a very positive experience with them.My $300-400 per month power bills are now zero, and I am even in $70 credit this month. So the investment was well worth it, and glad I chose SolarTactics to do it for me.

I rarely put out reviews but this company is worth reviewing. I have been researching panels & inverters (including articles/tips from SolarQuotes) and getting over a dozen quotes (including companies used by other friends) for a solar system for about 3-6 months before deciding to go with Solar Tactics and we are very happy with our decision.Communication is efficient both via email and phone. They answered all my queries including providing several quotes of various options for panel & inverter combination. I have had quotes from other companies whereby they either only provide what they want/sell or would not even give the option of trying different panel and inverter combination. Some companies are also resellers only. I have checked their ABN.Dennis was happy to come and see the location before starting the job. This is something important to us. Other companies I have requested will only rely on satellite images. It was good that Dennis came because he was able to check that the trees on the side were putting a lot of shadow on the location of the panels. He recommended we trim the trees which we did. Discussed panel locations with Dennis and he was happy to put some on the NE facing section to get the morning sun. Again, I have tried this with other companies and they prefer to only put all panels on one side, something I think is not maximizing the efficiency of the panels.Installation date was easy to organize even though we had to navigate Covid restrictions and my availability to be at home. Dennis and two other guys came to install the panels. They were very respectful and easy to deal with. They even had to work around my garage door not opening properly (inverter is in the garage). Installation was done neatly, no mess left behind. Replaced a couple of roof tiles. Requested drone photos of the roof after installation and was provided via email.Documents came in a pack and via email.Another important aspect I researched was that Solar Tactics is affiliated with an electrical company. This is important in the sense that they know what they are doing and also have certification to install solar systems. As mentioned above some companies are just resellers and would pass the job on to any installer which could be a potential issue in the future.We are now enjoying the benefits and would happily recommend Solar Tactics, and yes, they are a local business.Thank you Alan, Dennis and team.

We started a conversation about installing solar just before the last lockdown happened, so we had a bit of a bumpy ride. Although Solar Tactics have been in touch and pretty transparent about what was happening, which is good. When the lockdown ended, we got our panels installed shortly. Technically the guys did a great job, everything is working like a dream. I can definitely recommend.

I'm not one for writing reviews so I will keep it shortFriendlyeasy to deal withThey do what the say they are going to doThey looked after the roof while working on it, perfect installationWorked hard putting the inverter into my garage, no problem was too big to overcomeNo pushy sales tacticsHappy to answer any questions.Most of all they offered several options at a great priceWould I use Alan and the team again. YES, YES, YES
Seamless discussions with Jason.Perfect, all done in a day and very polite and tidy clean up.Excellent backup after installation. I mature and confident approach to the setup post-installation.

Overall great experience from getting a competitive quote from Jason (Solar Tactics) to feed-in approval to final installation/inspection.I am now using it for the last two weeks seeing my grid consumption is down to 80% hope this continues even with the panels when they get old.Also, it took them almost 6 weeks which was much faster than any other providers I will definitely recommend them.

Everything was taken care of by Allan and his team. The quotation was done within days of contacting solar tactics. Dennison and his installation team did a very tidy job and everything was explained. Connection to the grid was also taken care of promptly. Communication was great for every step of the whole process.

The whole process was great. We were recommended by our electrician and we are grateful for his recommendation. The entire process was seamless and the customer service throughout from both Alan and Dennison was great. When the instal had the independent check completed, the inspector said they have done an amazing job. I would highly recommend Solar Tactics.
Great solar installer, whole team was very pleasant to deal with from day 1. Alan was professional, patient and informative, and fantastic workmanship on the installation.

Sales quoting process was easy with good communication and availability over the time.The installation was good. The workmen were hard working, polite and friendly as well as punctual.The inspection and grid connection process went well also.

They came to my house to inspect before providing quote to ensure the design will be appropriate. They explained everything I need to know professionally and always get back to my call in timely manner.Installation was completed on time as scheduled and they setup the wifi connection for me and explained all I need to know about the app and inverter.They connected the grid and explained all the process that need to be completed.All in all, a very smooth process. It has been six months now since the installation and all still goes well.

A fantastic experence with Solar Tactics! My initial contact was with Jason. He guided me on what was the most aestically and top performaing system I can get on my property. The quoting process was a breeze, so long as I sent the required information (e.g photo of switchboard, copy of electricity bill and location of swithcboard). I was extremely happy to have recieved the quote promptly and followed up with Alan and he guided me through the quote and answered all of my questions and on how to progress through into the rebate. My system was instlaled within a month as the lockdown restricted movements, in which, Alan and Dennison kept me posted and updated on when the installation could occur.On install day, the team Dennison, Cal and Tony arrived punctually and suggested where to install the inverter. They never took the easy way out and spent extra time to make sure that install was as neat as possible! Our inverter is now a floating Primo! The installers were very polite and explained thoroughly on how to utilise and make the most of my system!Peregrina was very prompt in getting my system connected to the grid. She sent off all the paperwork promptly and kept me in the loop on what the process was and what entailed.
Did a great job, arrived on time, very professional. Organised the grid connection, set up the WiFi app to check real time solar generation very happy with the service.

Great experience with solar tactics. From the initial quote, Jason took on board my requested changes and came back with a fantastic proposal. He then kept me in the loop with the vic rebate process and installation timeframes. With the Vic lockdowns, he still kept me updated and offered options for installation dates. On install day, the team arrived on time and made great suggestions on inverter placement and location of conduits. They could have taken the easy way out and installed the inverter/cabling close to the meter box. But they took the extra time and work to put it in my garage and run the cables through multiple roof access points. Even took the trouble to run the main ac cable to my meter box in my interior brick work where other sparkies had previously said it was too hard. Definitely recommend this team and will let everyone I know who are looking for solar to give them a shout.

After reading multiple reviews from Solar quotes and having three quotes, I chose Solar Tactics.They were competitively priced and Alan was responsive and prompt to answer my (sometimes silly) questions without any hard sell.Dennison and the team arrived on time, were friendly and left the place spic and span.Peregrina  also made the grid connection process very smooth ,informing of the likely timelines and doing the required paperwork. As a result, this was quicker and less arduous than I had anticipated.After 3 months, things are working smoothly and no leaks, broken tiles or inverter breakdowns!All in all, this was a seamless  process at every step. and I am very satisfied with the final result.I have no hesitation recommending Solar tactics  for a solar installation. (I have already!)

Quoting was easy factual and they were very responsive to queries. We decided to go with a battery system and the whole system was installed quickly within 2 weeks of acceptance of quote. The installers were friendly, professional and we were thrilled with the finished product. They also took care of all the paperwork so can highly recommend them

Thanks Alan and Dennison for all your efforts on our solar system.  From the initial call to installation, they had so much patience with me as i wanted a specific system after doing my research.  Highly accommodating on my requests and didnt bat an eyelid unlike some other solar companies that tried to sell me something else.I'd give them 10 stars if i could for the following reasons;1. Competitively priced.2. Didnt keep following me up on sales calls to close the sale.3. Highly meticulous on the install and accommodated my requests.4. Super responsive on all my emails and calls.5. Take pride in their work and super honest.6. Local family run business, they have their own installers and stand by their work.7. Great aftersales service, i had some issues with reporting on my inverter (not their fault - manufacturers) and they were right onto it and resolved it next business day.8. Great work ethic, they literally put their customer first.  There was some personal issues that the installer was dealing with but still wanted to finish the job in the time frame they promised.9. Quality of install as you can see on the other reviews.10. Super tidy, they cleaned up everything throughout the day unlike some other trades!11. Went out of their way to replace a broken tile for me!I don't normally write reviews or recommend trades but i always refer this company to my friends given the experience i received from Solar Tactics.Looking forward to dealing with you again in the future.

From start to finish, Solar Tactics were fantastic. Proving quotes and explaining options regarding different systems.The installation team were clean, tidy & professional.Couldn't be happier with the solar system installed and service provided.
Happy customer from quotation to installation. Thank you Alan and Dennison's team.

I would highly recommend the team at Solar Tactics. The made the rather stressful process of selecting the invertor and amount of panel required easy. The quoting and sales process was easy and well-priced too.Prompt arrived on time for installation, fixed the roof and was super easy to work with.Had a good and easy communication line with the team.Also helped with organising the rebate process and post installation checks required.

We were referred to Solar Tactics by a friend who said they went over and above what they had to do so that sold it to me straight away. Alan was very informative and easy to deal with. Once our rebate part was approved it was installed very quickly and inspected within days of installation which was fantastic. After the inspection Ausnet came out within about a week or two alter our meter to connect to the grid. Everything ran smoothly and I would highly recommend Solar Tactics to anyone who is looking for a quality and reliable installer.

Solar Tactics were the first to get in touch after submitting through SolarQuotes. Their quote was well detailed and pricing was great.There was no pushiness and we took our time to evaluate all the quotes we received.Based mostly on reputation from SolarQuotes we elected to go with Solar Tactics, and this is where Alan really exceeded our expectations. Communication was excellent, thorough, yet casual.Installation day came, and Dennison and the guys again surpassed our expectations right from the beginning. Everyone was extremely courteous and mindful of our property. They answered all our questions with genuine thoughtful answers, and were able to work out a solution for a minor issue without any fuss.A few previously repaired tiles were relocated from under the panels location to a spot much easier for me to get to as we had no spares, and they even added some flashing to be extra safe.The attention to detail on the install is second to none. Silicone in all the right spots, perfect labeling, and the correct fixings everywhere.We have already recommend Solar Tactics to others for their professionalism and courtesy, and will continue to do so.Well done Solar Tactics!

Need a Solar System for your home? call them.highly recommended, great price for the quality, excellent customer care. I was worried about my old roof, but they work as an "elite".. quick and clean :) beautifully installed

We had our solar system designed and installed by Solar Tactics, and we found them to be exceptional throughout the whole process. Dennison was especially helpful when we were trying to decide which company to go with in this flooded, competitive market, sharing his knowledge and advice without being pushy in any way. The price was good, the installation work was neat and efficient, and the guys were friendly and professional throughout. We highly recommend them!

Alan, Dennison and the team were excellent to deal with. Alan gave an accurate and affordable quote with a realistic timeline for install. Dennison and his team arrived on time and worked quickly to get my system installed, they explained to me in detail how the system worked and what to look out for. They were extremely friendly with great customer service and I would highly recommend them.

Alan and the team at Solar Tactics were so easy to deal with and helpful along the way.  We had the interruption of Covid during our process but were kept informed all the way through to make sure we know when our installation could proceed.  The actual installation went so smoothly on our two story house that you couldn't tell they were even here.  everything left perfectly clean and the rood looks great with the panels installed.  We were led through the entire process, right to the end by Alan (and Peregrina) and are very thankful for their hard work.  5 stars all round.  Highly recommend.

Alan and his team recently installed solar panels in our investment property and we couldn't be happier. I approached them at a time when there were many covid challenges and Alan took the time and effort to keep us up to date on developments and provided realistic time frames in relation to installation. He went above and beyond to provide excellent customer service with efficient and thoughtful communication through out the process. Installation was easy and his team did a wonderful job. Our tenant is very happy and appreciative. I would highly recommend Solar Tactics.

Right from the quote to finish,everything was done perfectly and on the time that was promised. Very polite and friendly people who answered all our queries and made sure we understood. Very happy with work and already have recommended them to our family and friends.

I chose Solar Tactics after reading good reviews about them. The quoting process is smooth. They listened to our concerns and designed a system to our needs. Giving us quotes for different options. Responded to our questions promptly and professionally. The installation is excellent, they were punctual, tidy and polite. Solar Tactics organised all the necessary works after installation. Highly recommend!
Dennison and the team from Solar Tactics were great.  Good communication, competative price and very professional.  Would highly recommend.

The team at Solar Tactics were a pleasure to do business with.From the initial consult and quotation I could tell they were very professional and extremely knowledgeable.The install went smoothly and the team were a pleasure to have at our home.They were polite and punctual ,their workmanship was neat and tidy and showed they took pride in their work.Any small mess was quickly cleaned up .Their after install customer service helping organise the grid connection made it a breeze.I highly recommend Solar Tactics for any of your Solar needs.We were not eligible for any rebates and this is reflected in the price paid.Even without any rebates I feel we have got great value for money.

Everything from quoting till installation went very smoothly. They were was very helpful with providing as many quotes as possible till we could make a decision. Installation, even though, hit by COVID strict lock-downs was scheduled as soon as the restrictions were lifted. The customer service was awesome. They provided all the details regarding the system on the day and answered to all our question patiently. All the instructions regarding the communications with council, electricity provider, etc were provided very clearly. I would highly recommend Solar Tactics Tactics, don't waste your time communicating with other companies, they tick all the boxes!

It was a smooth journey from start to finish. I received the product and services that I was promised. From the start when I spoke with Alan on the phone, I realized that I am dealing with the right people. He is patient, polite and provides the information you need. Dennison and the installation crew arrived on time and explained how the solar panels will be installed. They were efficient and cleaned the site after they finished.Once the electrical inspector inspected the job, he commented " it was a nice job". You cannot go wrong with a family business that exceeds your expectations.

This was the 2nd solar install I have organised. The first install was with another ‘Platinum’ Solar Quotes rated supplier, which I was generally (but not totally) satisfied with.  The option was whether to go with the tried & tested or see if there was something better.  Solar Tactics fulfilled the latter and provided an exceptional customer service experience.1.	Timely and informative sales and support:  The team was very accessible. Communication was regular, timely and quotes detailed the specific equipment used (panels, inverter but also racking, isolator as well as isolating switch).  The inspection was organised promptly, as well as connection to the grid.2.	Competitive pricing: the quote provided excellent value for money for the services provided.3.	Organised, and thorough design/install process: The on-site assessment during design phase confirmed actual roof measurements and allowed an extra 4 panels (compared with another quote which was based on satellite imagery).
